import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the JOIN operation as specified in operation_history:
# JOIN : [["Source1_47_0", "Source1_47_1"], ["school_name", "school_name"]]
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Reorder and ensure columns match the target schema exactly:
# Target Schema: ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str,
# 'school_name': str, 'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int, 'School ID': int,
# 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
df_joined['Student ID'] = df_joined['Student ID'].astype(int)
df_joined['student_name'] = df_joined['student_name'].astype(str)
df_joined['gender'] = df_joined['gender'].astype(str)
df_joined['grade'] = df_joined['grade'].astype(str)
df_joined['school_name'] = df_joined['school_name'].astype(str)
df_joined['reading_score'] = df_joined['reading_score'].astype(int)
df_joined['math_score'] = df_joined['math_score'].astype(int)
df_joined['School ID'] = df_joined['School ID'].astype(int)
df_joined['type'] = df_joined['type'].astype(str)
df_joined['size'] = df_joined['size'].astype(int)
df_joined['budget'] = df_joined['budget'].astype(int)

# Select columns in the exact order of the target schema
df_target = df_joined[
    ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
     'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
